results.description:
Don't miss the BRAND NEW utterly charming, romantic read from BESTSELLER Camilla Isley

This season, love deserves a comeback story.

Dr. Lila Callaway excels at putting broken things back together. But she could never mend her heart after Asher Wayne, the boy who promised her forever, chose football over their relationship. Years later, she runs the physical therapy department at Blue Crescent Medical Center, keeping her life orderly, safe, and free of infuriatingly charming athletes.

Until a severe ankle injury sidelines the NFL superstar. He belongs in world-class facilities, not a small-town clinic. But Ash will only let Lila oversee his rehabilitation, pushing all her buttons and looking far too handsome during their grueling daily sessions.

Lila establishes strict boundaries: no personal questions, no reminiscing, and absolutely no acknowledging the explosive chemistry still burning between them. Ash agrees to her terms, yet every intense exercise and lingering glance chips away at her ironclad defenses. He claims he returned for his recovery, but his relentless focus remains on her, making his temporary homecoming feel like a play for keeps.

Thirteen years apart, ten weeks of forced proximity, will it be enough for a second chance at first love?

Praise for Camilla Isley:

'A romcom full of wit, charm, sexual chemistry and brains.' Laura Carter

'Sexy, funny, romantic and heartfelt - this book has it all - a must read.' Sandy Barker

'A fast-paced, entertaining will-they-won't-they that kept me on tenterhooks to the end.' Phoebe MacLeod

‘The chemistry between the characters was impeccable.’ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
